svg.title: Organize projects in terminal tabs and tools in panes
svg.desc: A computer shows one terminal window with project tabs for heat-birthweight, review-times and website. The selected project tab contains a Zellij layout: Claude Code fills the left pane, pueue queue status occupies the upper-right pane, and btop shows CPU activity, memory use and processes in the lower-right pane. Shared dividers and one status bar identify a single terminal workspace.
svg.text: Projects in tabs, tools in panes
